categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Resolves the fine case through early payment before enforcement actions are triggered. Advances 'Maximize timely fine revenue' and 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost'. Judged against Indicator 'Time to fine dispatch (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative task id=12 as seen in frequent early payment variants like V0002 and V0007.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Resolves the fine case through payment after notifications or penalties have been added. Advances 'Maximize timely fine revenue'. Judged against Indicator 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative task id=13, supported by variants where payment occurs following notification and penalty steps such as V0004, V0005, and V0006.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Contested appeal resolved via administrative channels through the Prefecture. Preserves 'Preserve offender's due-process rights' while impacting administrative costs. Judged against Indicator 'Time to appeal filing, Prefecture (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative task id=14 (and its AND-decomposed child tasks 15, 16, 17, 18), evidenced by variants containing appeal insertion, sending, and receiving results like V0008, V0057, and V00137.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Contested appeal resolved via judicial channels through the Judge. Strongly advances due-process rights while increasing costs. Judged against Indicator 'Time to appeal filing, Judge (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative task id=19, evidenced by narrative variants containing 'Appeal to Judge' activities such as V0103, V0176, and V0140.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Enforced case closed through coercive credit collection measures. Advances fine revenue but hurts enforcement costs and due-process. Judged against Indicator 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative task id=20, evidenced by variants terminating in 'Send for Credit Collection' such as V0001, V0009, and V0134.
